subject: Class 197 Civity DMU, Transport for Wales, 2024
method: Body from the operator's diagram (the 195's template behind a gangway), face from 197006; every number's source in `trace`.

calibration.notes: dias West-Midland-Trains-Class-196-0 and TfW-Class-197-3-Car (128 px tall, the 195's template behind an 11 px gangway): vertical 32.2 px/m from row 126.5; the 197's car 1 11-835 px = 824 px = 24.026 m (34.3 px/m, the 195's scale); the 196's car 1 11-898 px has one more window bay: scaled to the published 24.03 m (36.9 px/m), the diagram and the published length disagree by 7%: a side-on photo should settle it

trace.nose.profile: dias: the gangway's bellows 0-4 px, the face flat behind it from the bumper (rows 91-106) to the roof's edge (row 2-6 at 23 px: 0.35 m back); the chin back to 1.0 m at 0.30
trace.face: 197006 near head-on (TfW, 2000 px), scaled by the face's width at the lamps (375 px for 2.712 m: 138 px/m; each half by its own width, the view from the right), up from the face's foot at 1.04 m: a black-framed gangway door standing 0.32 m proud (frame +-0.57 m, 0.96-3.66 m; door +-0.36, 1.06-3.48), each side a screen in a black frame (glass 0.59-1.19 m out, 2.03-3.24), a lamp pod 0.76-1.32 out, 1.30-1.79; grey cheek boxes below the face's foot and the coupler between. Shared by the 196 (same front, 196002/196114)
trace.livery: dia: light grey body (#D0D6E2), red doors; 197006 (photo): the cab's top red down to 3.39 m with an orange line under it, red roof edges
trace.livery.branding: AW (the Transport for Wales logo: red T roundel, two lines of lettering) low under the windows between the cab door and door 1: 197003 (Chester) read along by a projective fit through seven door and window edges (residuals to 17 cm), 3.99-5.72 m; up from the window's foot (1.85 m, 169 px/m) 1.32-1.65 m; width and height agree with the artwork's 5.1 aspect (0.34 m).
